attato.g: “idhekacco rūpaṁ attato samanupassati. Yaṁ rūpaṁ so ahaṁ, yo ahaṁ taṁ rūpanti rūpañca attañca advayaṁ samanupassati, seyyathāpi nāma telappadīpassa jhāyato yā acci so vaṇṇo, yo vaṇṇo sā accīti acciñca vaṇṇañca advayaṁ samanupassati.
